description: Create an asynchronous orbit turnaround from a project image or a public HTTPS image. To use your own picture, import it first with lab_add_media (art image) and pass the returned asset_key here. Costs credits without get_cost: quote the price first and wait for the person's confirmation, then pass max_credits. Never automatically retry a paid run. Pass job_id to poll the existing run; it takes precedence over starting and needs no project or image. The selected views are approximate angle estimates, unvalidated on AI characters.

asset_key.description: The asset_key of an image imported into this project with lab_add_media (art image); give this OR startbild to start.

get_cost.description: Return the catalog price and current balance without starting or charging anything.

job_id.description: Existing orbit job id as a positive integer string; polls status and approximate views.

max_credits.description: Maximum credits confirmed by the person, as a nonnegative integer string; required to start.

nur_eigene_daten.description: Only for a model that sends inputs to China or a US recipient without a documented basis, when the step carries images, clips, voices or faces. Means: this material shows or contains no real person other than the human using this account. Set it ONLY after the human has said exactly that for THIS step; never assume it, never reuse it for the next step. Not needed when the human has declared this material in the FilmLab app: the backend reads that declaration, also for material derived from it; only the app can store one. An LK reference, a licensed likeness or another person's agreement does not replace it. Without it the backend refuses with drittland_dritte_gesperrt before any charge; then use a non-gated model or text only.

project_id.description: Project id as a positive integer string; required to start.

startbild.description: Address of an image owned by this project or a public HTTPS image; give this OR asset_key to start.

name: lab_orbit
title: Orbit Turnaround
